FULL TEXT:
TRANSLATOR AND TRANSLATOR-CUM-PROOF READER (FOR SUVAS CELL)
RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2024
NOTICE
No.- 03 /R&A Dated: 20th January, 2026
In continuation to this Court’s Notice No. 98/R&A dated 16.12.2025, it is hereby notified that:
1. In consideration of his prayer, Sri Santosh Kumar (Roll No.103052) was granted another
extension till 10.01.2026 to report for joining to the post of Translator (SUVAS Cell). On
account of his non-joining within the aforesaid period (i.e. by 10.01.2026) granted to
him, the Hon’ble Court have been pleased to cancel his selection/appointment.
2. Sri Govind Rajak (Roll No. 103495) was granted last chance to report for joining to the
post of Translator (SUVAS Cell) by 25.12.2025. On account of his non-joining within
aforesaid period (i.e. by 25.12.2025) granted to him, the Hon’ble Court have been pleased
to cancel his selection/appointment.
By order of the Court
Sd/- P. K. Malik
Registrar General
